translations.web: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.
translations.bsb: Therefore, brothers, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.
translations.kjv: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
translations.asv: Wherefore, brethren, we are not children of a handmaid, but of the freewoman.
